FICTIONAL EXAMPLE DOCUMENT. The materials, laboratories and measurements below are invented for software testing.

Correction notice: Faradaic efficiency of RT-1

This notice corrects the RT-1 oxygen evolution report published earlier by the same group and supersedes the efficiency value given there.

After publication, the authors found that the fluorescence oxygen probe had been calibrated against a reference gas with an incorrectly certified oxygen fraction. The original calibration overstated the detected oxygen.

Recalculating all runs with a recertified reference gas, the corrected Faradaic efficiency of RT-1 for oxygen evolution is 91%, not the 99% stated in the original report. The remaining charge is attributed to partial ruthenium dissolution, which was confirmed by mass spectrometry of the electrolyte.

The activity data, overpotentials and morphology results in the original report are unaffected. The conclusion that RT-1 is a near-unity efficiency anode is withdrawn. The authors regret the error.
